description:
What a plan would change, one line per item: for a draft or a plan awaiting approval, each item against the organisation now (added, changed, unchanged); for an applied or reverted plan, what its apply changed. Changes nothing. Free.

With an API key, the plan's invitations, reviewers and lookup lists read 'unchecked': a key does not learn the organisation's people or lists.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Returns: { plan_id, revision, status, basis: current | applied, counts: { added, changed, removed, unchanged, unchecked }, lines: ["<change> <path> <id> \"<name>\": <what changes>"], link }
name: handinloop_get_plan_diff
title: What an Onboarding Plan Would Change
